style: Use case: game UI concept art for Xóm Đảo, a cozy Vietnamese island-village game hub for mobile web. Finished in-game screenshot, landscape phone 19.5:9, target 2340x1080, edge-to-edge game pixels, no phone frame, no poster, no marketing title, no instructional copy, no watermark. Art direction: flat cartoon 2.5D mobile game art, clean color blocks, soft outlines, simple cel shading with short soft shadows, minimal texture (no detailed wood grain, moss, water caustics or cinematic lighting), bright daylight from the upper left, consistent across the image. Palette: clear turquoise sea, warm sand, bamboo green, terracotta roof tiles, cream paper, honey wood, accents of lantern red and brass gold. World flavor: small Vietnamese coastal village (xóm chài) - bamboo, rope, woven baskets, fishing boats, terracotta roofs, paper lanterns. UI is part of the world, not an app: panels are honey wood signboards with rope ties and cream giấy dó paper insets, buttons are chunky rounded wooden or lacquered plaques with a soft bevel, the currency is a brass coin with a square hole called xu. Never use a mobile app tab bar, flat material pills or a full-width top bar. HUD only sits in the screen corners. Typography: rounded bold display font for titles, clean readable sans for small text, exact Vietnamese diacritics, dark brown text on paper, cream text on wood.

assets.hub-world: The hub home screen. A slightly tilted top-down view of a calm archipelago. In the center a larger village island 'Xóm' with four clearly distinct landmark buildings, each with a small hanging wooden name sign: a cozy home with terracotta roof 'Nhà', a busy market stall 'Chợ', a communal village hall with a notice board 'Đình', a wooden harbor with docked little boats 'Bến'. Around it, generous sea and 7 small game islands, each a compact toy diorama with a short wooden sign: playing cards fan 'Tiến Lên', xiangqi fortress 'Cờ Tướng', X and O coral 'Caro', ludo horses 'Cá Ngựa', little monopoly town 'Tỷ Phú', grey battleship harbor 'Hải Chiến', foggy locked islet with a small padlock. Near the right edge one festive event island glowing with red paper lanterns and a mid-autumn moon flag, a small ribbon sign 'Trung Thu · 5 ngày'. Tiny fishing boats sail between islands, a few gulls. Corner HUD only: top-left a round avatar in a bamboo ring with name 'Minh' and a small level badge '12'; top-right a wooden plaque with a brass xu coin and '2.450', a small leaf-green gem with '38', then a round wooden gear button; bottom-right one big lacquered red-gold plaque button 'Chơi nhanh' with a play icon. Nothing else on screen.
assets.island-enter: Entering a game island. The camera is zoomed onto the 'Tiến Lên' island on the left two thirds: a sandy island shaped like a fan of giant playing cards with palm trees and a small pavilion where tiny villagers play cards, a wooden dock with three small moored boats each flying a tiny flag. On the right third a tall hanging honey-wood signboard panel with rope ties, title 'Tiến Lên', a green dot and '32 đang chơi', a large lacquered red-gold button 'Chơi nhanh', a smaller wooden button 'Tạo phòng', then a short list on cream paper of three open rooms, each row with a tiny boat icon, room name and seats: 'Bàn của Lan  3/4', 'Hội cuối tuần  2/4', 'Bàn của Tú  1/4', with a small 'Vào' button per row. A small rolled scroll icon labeled 'Luật' at the panel bottom. Top-left corner a round wooden back-arrow button. Top-right the wooden xu plaque '2.450' and gear button. Soft vignette on the outer sea.
assets.in-game-hud: In a match of Tiến Lên (Vietnamese card game) for 4 players. Center: a round woven bamboo mat table on a wooden deck by the sea, cards just played in the middle. Bottom center: the local player's hand of 13 fanned playing cards, two cards lifted. Above the hand to the right two chunky buttons: lacquered red-gold 'Đánh' and wooden 'Bỏ lượt'. Three opponents seated left, top and right of the table, each shown as a round avatar in a bamboo ring with a name on a tiny wooden tag and a small card-count chip, the current turn opponent ringed by a glowing gold timer arc. Top-left corner: a round wooden back-arrow button. Top-right corner: round wooden speaker and gear buttons. Bottom-left corner: a small round wooden emote button with a smiling face. No other HUD, no game title on screen, the table owns the middle of the screen.
assets.match-result: End-of-match results over a softly blurred card table by the sea. A centered honey-wood signboard panel with rope ties and a cream paper inset, title 'Thắng rồi!' with small confetti and paper lantern accents. A ranked list of 4 players with round avatars in bamboo rings: '1  Minh' with a small gold crown, '2  Lan', '3  Tú', '4  Hải'. Below, a rewards row: brass xu coins '+120' and a leaf-green gem '+2', with several brass coins flying in an arc toward the top-right corner xu plaque that shows '2.570'. Two buttons at the panel bottom: lacquered red-gold 'Chơi tiếp' and wooden 'Về đảo'. Top-right corner shows the xu plaque and gear button only.
assets.home-profile: Inside the player's cozy home 'Nhà', a warm wooden interior with a window to the sea and hanging plants. On the left, a large paper-on-wood profile card: big round avatar in a bamboo ring, name 'Minh', level badge '12' with a short progress bar, three small stat chips '128 ván', '64 thắng', '9 thành tích'. On the right, wooden shelves acting as an inventory grid of 12 cubbies holding collectible items: decorated card backs, avatar frames of bamboo, lotus and dragon, a red lantern, a little boat, a few empty cubbies. Above the shelves, physical bookmark-like wooden tabs 'Túi đồ', 'Thành tích', 'Xếp hạng' with 'Túi đồ' active. Top-left corner a round wooden back-arrow button. Top-right the xu plaque '2.450' and gear button.
assets.event-island: A limited-time festival event. The Trung Thu (mid-autumn) event island fills the left half at dusk: lantern-lit stilt houses, a big glowing star lantern, a full moon low over the sea, tiny villagers releasing floating lanterns on the water. On the right a festive event signboard panel in deep red lacquer and gold trim with a cream paper inset: title 'Lễ hội Trung Thu', a small hourglass and 'Còn 5 ngày', a horizontal reward track of 5 stages with lantern icons, the first two checked, items shown as small icons (xu coins, a moon cake, a lantern avatar frame, a rabbit card back, a star lantern), a large lacquered gold button 'Tham gia'. Top-left a round wooden back-arrow button, top-right xu plaque and gear button.
assets.ui-kit: A clean UI style sheet board for this game, arranged in a tidy grid on a soft cream background with small Vietnamese labels: primary button lacquered red-gold 'Chơi nhanh' in normal, pressed and disabled states; secondary honey wood button 'Tạo phòng' in the same three states; round icon buttons (back arrow, gear, speaker, emote, close); a honey-wood signboard panel with rope ties and a cream paper inset; a small toast notification on paper; currency plaques (brass square-hole xu coin '2.450', leaf-green gem '38'); avatar in bamboo ring with level badge and three alternative avatar frames; a toggle switch and a slider made of bamboo; tab bookmarks; a typography sample 'Xóm Đảo' in the rounded display font and 'Chơi với bạn bè' in the body font; a color palette row of 8 swatches. Flat even lighting, product sheet presentation.
lobby: The main lobby (home screen) in the layout language of popular mobile MOBA and battle-royale games, redrawn in this Vietnamese cartoon island style. Center stage: a small round village island 'Xóm' with a terracotta-roof house and a banyan tree, and the player's chibi villager character (boy with a conical nón lá hat, simple áo bà ba) standing proudly in the middle, slightly larger than everything else. Around it on the sea, five genre islands, each a toy diorama with a short wooden name sign: 'Cờ' (xiangqi and go boards with stone pieces), 'Bài' (fan of giant playing cards and a pavilion), 'Tiệc' (ludo horses, dice and a tiny monopoly town), 'Đối Kháng' (cute bomb volcano with sparks and a small arena), and a glowing lantern festival island 'Trung Thu' with a red ribbon '5 ngày'. HUD like a mobile game lobby: top-left round avatar in bamboo ring with name 'Minh' and level badge '12'; top-right row of wooden plaques: brass xu coin '2.450', green gem '38', a mail envelope button with a red dot, a gear button. Left edge: a vertical column of three round wooden icon buttons with tiny labels 'Sự kiện', 'Nhiệm vụ', 'Bạn bè', one with a red notification dot. Right edge: a vertical column of two icon buttons 'Chợ' and 'Túi đồ'. Bottom-left: a short row of square wooden icon buttons with tiny labels 'Nhà', 'Xếp hạng', 'Thành tích', 'Bến'. Bottom-right: a selected-game card plaque showing a small card-fan thumbnail, 'Tiến Lên' and '4 người', with a small swap arrow, and right below it one huge glowing lacquered red-gold button 'CHƠI', plus a smaller wooden button 'Tạo phòng' beside it. Lively, glowing, busy like a real mobile game lobby, but every element is wood, bamboo, rope, lacquer or paper.
assets.genre-select: The game selection screen for one genre, like the map selection screen of a battle-royale mobile game. Background: a blurred close-up of the 'Bài' card island. Top center: a horizontal row of genre tabs shaped like small wooden island plaques: 'Cờ', 'Bài' (active, glowing gold), 'Tiệc', 'Đối Kháng', 'Sự kiện'. Middle: a horizontal scrolling row of large vertical game cards with rounded wooden frames, each card has a painted illustration on top and a cream paper name plate below: 'Tiến Lên' (card pavilion by the sea, selected, larger, with a gold glowing frame and a check mark), 'Mậu Binh' (three rows of cards on a mat), 'Bài Cào' (three cards and coins on a woven tray), and a fourth card half cut off at the right edge, foggy with a padlock, 'Sắp có'. Each card shows small chips '2–4 người' and a green dot with an online count. Right side of the screen: a narrow detail panel for the selected game on paper inset in a wooden frame: title 'Tiến Lên', a one-line tagline 'Đánh hết bài trước để thắng', chips '4 người' and '12 phòng đang mở', buttons: big lacquered red-gold 'Chọn', wooden 'Tạo phòng', wooden 'Danh sách phòng', and a small scroll icon 'Luật'. Top-left round wooden back-arrow button; top-right xu plaque '2.450' and gear button.
